validation.rust: passed full feature-web suite including stress, Clippy and fmt
validation.pinned_corpora: passed pinned full corpus regressions; all four complete raw corpus reports byte-identical
validation.browser: passed complete browser/HTTP suite including all 347 policy judgments, retained/conflicting paths, API/CLI/export parity, desktop/mobile layout; screenshots inspected
validation.nix: passed nix flake check --offline and nix build --offline .#klem .#web on x86_64-linux; other flake systems not built

validation.release_performance: three interleaved release runs per version/filter completed; samples recorded below

limitations: Independent Korean-language review remains pending. These source-backed policy judgments are not a measured precision benchmark.

The native inventory has 75 ㄷ entries (50 regular, 22 irregular, 3 unknown) and 49 ㅅ entries (15 regular, 32 irregular, 2 unknown). Each full primary entry and all senses/notes/written forms are preserved with English equivalents.

Five entries have no usable written 니 paradigm: 껴묻다, 내딛다, 딛다, 잡숫다, 줄짓다. Some shortened stems have consonant-only attachment notes; keeping their unknown hypothesis is not a grammaticality claim or permission to ignore those unimplemented restrictions.

걷다 and 묻다 have actual regular/irregular homonyms. A complete reading survives when a matching entry supports it, while conflicting per-entry assessments remain visible. This does not determine the intended sense of a sentence.

Literal consonant endings have no spelling obligation. Vowel endings, honorific/past prefinals, nominalizations and auxiliaries retain distinct owners; requirements from different alternative derivations are never conjoined.

Raw components/order/rule IDs and headword-only candidates remain unchanged across the measured sets. Four full-JSON snapshots retain their prior hashes and test preservation after removing only the new ㄷ/ㅅ metadata.

EntryMatch adds optional digeut and siot written-form evidence. ConjugationEvidence is the shared Rust structure; HieutEvidence remains a type alias. Old JSON without the added fields remains readable and unknown conservatively. Rust struct literals must initialize the new fields; exhaustive SpellingClass matches must handle four new variants. Database schema is unchanged.

Eight training target groups remain available after compatible filtering; complete original sentences and all frozen corpus reports are preserved. Gold annotations and held-out baselines are unchanged.
All compatible-filter novel removals are traced independently to lexical_spelling conflicts in the headword-only output. This is conflict-policy evidence, not contextual precision.
Broader ㅂ/르 and other lexical inflection compatibility remains open under COV-021, along with other tracked spelling/shortening classes.

release_performance.method: Three interleaved release CLI runs per version/filter, including startup, dictionary access and JSONL serialization; stdout discarded. Linux per-child peak RSS. Measurements do not establish statistical equivalence.
